outputs.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL: panel C top shows a box-and-whisker plot of total polyp number per genotype, but the caption only states 'the mean numbers and sizes of intestinal polyps' with n and P-values, without defining what the box, median line or whiskers represent (e.g., IQR, min/max, SD).
FAIL: the bar graph of relative GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 shows error bars, but the caption describes only the pulldown method and gives no definition (e.g., SD, SEM) or sample size for the error bars.

FAIL: the 'Relative expression' bar graph (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) contains error bars, but the caption only describes the immunoblotting/zymography experiment and loading controls, without defining the error bars or stating replicate numbers.
